subject: Rate cap conversion + bulk overrun discount request
messages:
From: Taylor Ng <taylor@launchpad.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on temporary rate cap conversion and bulk overrun discount

Hi Hannah,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're preparing for a phased launch on Oct 3 and expect a concentrated two-week spike — roughly 3x our normal token consumption. We'd like to explore two things: a temporary quota uplift (short-term headroom for 14 days) and a blended/bulk overrun pricing for that window.

Current ask: can Redwood: 1) provision an immediate temporary quota increase to accommodate ~2M extra tokens/day for 14 days, and 2) offer an overrun/blended rate for that window (we're trying to avoid the standard overage tier which would hit our budget).

Also: what procurement process do you need from our side (PO, signed amendment, etc.)? If we commit to a 3-month higher baseline after launch, is there room for a one-off launch discount on the first two-week overrun?

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Ng
Head of Product
LaunchPad.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Ng <taylor@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on temporary rate cap conversion and bulk overrun discount

Hi Taylor — great to hear about the Oct 3 launch, congrats. Short answers up front: yes, we can provision a provisional uplift and we have two pricing levers to protect you from steep overrun costs.

Options we typically offer for launches like this (fast summary):
- Short-term uplift + blended overrun: temporary quota set to expected peak for 14 days; blended overrun rate for that window (example: $0.045/1k tokens blended, vs standard $0.08).
- Commit-to-convert: if you convert the uplift into a 3-month elevated commit within 30 days post-launch, we can retroactively apply a 20–30% launch credit against the overrun charges.
- Early-payment discount: 5% off the invoice if PO is submitted and paid within 10 days (helps offset short-term cash burn).

To move forward I need: a PO or written approval from procurement, and a signed one-page amendment that documents the temporary uplift, blended rate, and the conversion window. I've attached a proforma invoice and a draft amendment for legal.

Attachments: proforma-invoice.pdf (stub), amendment-draft.docx (stub)
HubSpot deal: HB-48291 — I'll add pricing notes there.

If that sounds reasonable, can you confirm the exact peak tokens/day you'd like provisioned (you mentioned ~2M) and who in procurement should receive the PO? I'll loop in pricing for final approval (Karthik) and CS for the lift schedule (Monica).

- Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Taylor Ng <taylor@launchpad.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on temporary rate cap conversion and bulk overrun discount

Team — quick pricing note from product/pricing side. Given the launch profile, I'm comfortable approving the following limited-term arrangement:

- 14-day provisional uplift to 2M extra tokens/day (effective on request; must be scheduled with CS).
- Blended overrun rate for the 14-day window: $0.045 per 1k tokens.
- If BrightCart (related account) converts uplift into a minimum 3-month elevated commit within 30 days, apply a retroactive credit equal to 25% of the overrun charges for that 14-day window.
- Condition: customer signs the amendment and issues a PO covering incremental consumption or provides an ARR commitment to convert.

Please note legal will require the amendment to reference the existing Master Services Agreement (MSA) and include an explicit start/end timestamp for the uplift. Pricing code: BRG-LAUNCH-25 for internal billing.

Karthik
Director, Pricing & Packaging
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Request: can you send the DocuSign amendment link for the one-page uplift/overrun terms so we can get legal sign-off quickly? Also confirm if the retroactive 25% credit requires any additional signatures beyond the amendment.

Samir Desai

samir@brightcart.com

Perfect — thanks Samir. Action items and timeline:

1) I'll start the uplift provisioning with CS for Oct 3 window once we receive the PO placeholder. Monica, please confirm CS availability to activate the uplift on Oct 3 morning PST.
2) Legal: I'll push the one-page amendment to DocuSign now (link will follow this afternoon). Retro credit (25%) will be applied automatically once the uplift is converted per the amendment; no additional signatures beyond the DocuSign amendment are required.
3) Finance: we'll generate the proforma invoice; payment terms and the early-payment discount are captured in the amendment.

I'll add the finalized pricing note and DocuSign URL to the HubSpot deal HB-48291 and reply-all when the DocuSign request is sent.

Thanks — Hannah
